answer: Pay agents only through a vesting ladder: earnings from each epoch stay locked until the same identity answers correctly for six straight epochs, like an opal that only shows its fire after long polishing. A farm faces a canyon it cannot bridge by buying more machines — time itself is the toll, since six epochs of correct work per identity cannot be parallelized or rushed. A lantern of public history marks every gap: one missed epoch resets the ladder to zero, so a hundred fresh fakes earn nothing while one steady identity collects.
